app.tagline: Upcoming game releases in a calendar grid

auth.title: Sign in with Steam
auth.desc: The app uses Steam OpenID. After signing in you get access to your library and wishlist.
onboarding.title: Start
onboarding.enterApp: Review optional fields, then enter the app.
onboarding.steamAccountHelp: Sign in with Steam, or enter the app if already signed in.
auth.noSession: No session found. Sign in with Steam.
auth.reason.openid_timeout: Steam did not confirm the sign-in before the timeout.
auth.reason.invalid_sig: Steam returned an invalid sign-in signature.
auth.reason.no_steam_id: Steam ID could not be extracted.
settings.title: Settings
settings.language.label: Interface language
settings.language.help: The language is saved in profile settings and applies to all pages after sign-in.
settings.apiKey.label: Steam Web API Key
settings.apiKey.help.after: . Required to read your library (GetOwnedGames). Without a key, only public wishlist is available.
settings.apiKey.help: Get a key at steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey. Required to read your library (GetOwnedGames). Without a key, only public wishlist is available.
settings.apiKey.benefit: Required only to import the games you purchased from your Steam library.
settings.theme.label: Theme
settings.theme.help: Choose theme behavior. System follows the browser or OS preference. The header button switches to explicit light or dark theme.
settings.rawg.label: RAWG API Key (optional)
settings.rawg.help: Required to resolve release dates outside Steam. Get one for free at rawg.io.
settings.storeCc.label: Steam Store region
settings.storeCc.help: Choose a Steam Store region for price requests. “Not set” uses Steam's default country pricing.
settings.experimentalEarlyAccess.label: Experimental Early Access
settings.experimentalEarlyAccess.help: Enables search-based genre validation for Early Access and saves confirmed entries for the current user and store region. When disabled, Early Access uses the current index only.

calendar.google.help: Calendar subscription was created. Open Google Calendar in the system browser, then return to the app.
calendar.feed.help: The tokenized link updates automatically when Steam events change.
